introHtml: Recycled PET tumblers and travel mugs are made from post-consumer plastic bottles, giving your brand a genuine sustainability story. Unlike standard plastic drinkware, these eco-friendly options reduce waste without sacrificing durability or insulation. Ideal for trade shows, employee gifts, or retail giveaways, they accept full-color imprinting and come in popular sizes like 16 oz and 24 oz. Choose recycled PET to show your audience you care about the planet while keeping their drinks at the perfect temperature.
